why: Five Chuck's Crew specials/trap shipped with no plate, so the app asked for art that 404'd. Mark asked for these five to be made in Gemini as strict photorealism. On 19 Nov 2026 (8:15 PM) Mark asked for every image to convey the card's actual in-game effect as a tongue-in-cheek gag, so all five were remade in Gemini from effect-led prompts (first attempt each); two got a documented local retouch. On 19 Nov 2026 Mark made ck-top-up and ck-quiet-word pure battle cards: object still lifes with no teddy, plush, Chuck or people.
generator: Gemini (Mark's Google AI Plus plan), by hand at gemini.google.com; exact prompt and reference image (or none) per plate below. The Chuck plates had a Chuck reference image attached; the battle cards had no reference image. Not called from the repo. Fal and other hosted generators remain banned.
pipeline: scripts/inpaint-card-art-fooocus.py --export-from (sharp cover crop to 768x1024 WebP + 192x256 thumb), then npm run art:thumbs --force (thumb/mid WebP+AVIF)
design_record: art/bear-bibles.json keeps each card's signature (character: chuck for the Chuck plates; kind: battle, plush: false for the battle cards); the Fooocus manifest rows are composed from it.
superseded: Earlier versions (a Fooocus pass, then Gemini photoreal and battle-card still lifes, merged at 8742e3f) were replaced because they did not show the in-game effect; backups at /workspace/missingart/backup-8742e3f and in git history.

plates.name: Last Orders
plates.generator: Gemini (Mark's Google AI Plus plan), by hand at gemini.google.com
plates.reference_image: chuck-ref.png (Mark's Gemini Chuck design) attached in the Gemini chat
plates.prompt: Keep this exact character design (same plush teddy bartender), but render him as a real physical plush toy in a real photograph. Ringside sports photograph, 35mm, low angle from the canvas. In the corner of a real boxing ring under a single hard white overhead spotlight, Chuck sits on the corner stool, visibly battered: a sticking plaster on his brow, an ice pack sliding off his head, a few tufts of stuffing poking from a split seam on one shoulder. One adult lady plush teddy cornerwoman in a short pink satin robe tips a frosty pint of lager straight into his open mouth like a cornerman's water bottle, foam splashing down his teal shirt, and he is already springing up off the stool mid-gulp, flexing one plush bicep, eyes wide and roaring back to life. A second adult lady plush teddy in a matching robe and red boxing gloves bumps her gloves together behind him, grinning, fired up and ready to hit harder, giving his flex a cheeky appreciative once-over. Red ring ropes, royal-blue canvas, white towels, a spit bucket, sweat droplets and lager spray frozen in the spotlight, dark crowd falling to black. Palette: royal blue, scarlet, white and pink. Hyper-realistic real-world photograph, not an illustration, not a painting, not a cartoon, not 3D render, not CGI. Full-frame DSLR, real lens optics, true-to-life lighting, physically accurate shadows and reflections, natural material texture, fine film grain. Visible real fabric fibres and stitching on every plush toy. Chuck is a real, physical adult plush teddy bear toy (stuffed animal, not a living bear, not a human): honey-brown mohair plush, barrel chest, greying muzzle fur, half-lidded glass eyes, a loosened black satin bow tie, a teal short-sleeve shirt unbuttoned at the collar, one small gold tooth. All characters are adult plush teddy bear toys photographed in a real location; cheeky adult humour by innuendo only. Absolutely no wooden bar counter, no wood panelling, no bottle shelves, no warm amber, orange or brown light. Portrait 3:4, subject centred with headroom for a card frame. No text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, signage or watermark anywhere. No humans, no children.
plates.effect: Special, cost 4, rare. At 5 HP or less: heal 6 and every creature you control gets +1 attack. Otherwise heal 3. A Pour on your side adds +2 to the heal. (barService.playBarSpecial 'lastOrders', LAST_ORDERS_HP = 5)
plates.gag: Boxing-ring corner comeback: a battered, nearly-out Chuck on the corner stool gets a pint poured into him like a cornerman's water bottle and springs back flexing (low-HP big heal), while his two adult lady-teddy cornerwomen raise their gloves, fired up (+1 attack to the table).
plates.retouch: Local OpenCV retouch on the box (/workspace/missingart/retouch.py, no generator): the dim crowd strips either side of the cornerwomen burned down to dark shapes so no human face is readable.
